atomic_qas.question: How do you plan for people with very different experience?
atomic_qas.answer: I prepare a basic task that stands on its own and an extension that adds responsibility. Nobody has to leave the group to find an appropriate challenge.

atomic_qas.question: What do you ask experienced participants to do?
atomic_qas.answer: I ask them to notice what helps the table move together. Expertise becomes generous when it creates room instead of setting the pace.

atomic_qas.question: What would you change in your next mixed group?
atomic_qas.answer: I would let participants decide when the extension becomes useful. That choice may show me forms of difficulty I did not anticipate.
